name: Singer 2026 • Malaysia
overview:
A global sensation takes a bold new leap.

For the first time ever, Singer (歌手), previously known as I Am a Singer (我是歌手), goes international and it all begins in Malaysia.

Singer 2026 • Malaysia (歌手2026 • 马来西亚篇) brings together elite vocalists from across cultures for a high-stakes, no-second-chances showdown. Staying true to its core – True Live. Real Talent, this is where professional singers go head-to-head on one stage, in a competition defined by authenticity and vocal excellence.

Powered by ASTRO and MANGO TV, this groundbreaking production connects audiences across borders like never before.

Multilingual. Multicultural. Made for the World.
